name: grokchat
description: A Next.js chat app and a Python API that connect to orbit/grokbot. The Python half (:50930, stdlib only) proxies chat, models and bots to grokbot on :50890, forwards the caller's mod-protocol token and BYOK x-xai-key untouched, streams SSE through byte-for-byte, and knocks the activator if grokbot is asleep. The Next.js half (:3930, basePath /grokchat) is the chat surface: pick a model, paste a key or sign in, watch tokens stream in. Nothing is stored here — identity and keys stay grokbot's problem.
backend: api.py — python stdlib only (http.server + urllib), proxy to grokbot
frontend: app/ — Next.js 14, basePath /grokchat: grokbot's mark+palette, wallet sign-in (same token slot as the grokbot console), MY GROKBOTS (create/edit/publish/delete), EXPLORE everyone's published bots (chat/copy), bot dropdown, xAI key, streaming chat

auth.passthrough: Authorization: Bearer <mod token> and x-xai-key are forwarded to grokbot verbatim; grokbot resolves identity and the xAI key

endpoints.chat: POST /chat {prompt|messages, model, system, bot, search, stream}
